Senate.text: Referred to State and Local Government

additions: an extension is requested by the governor and approved by the legislature under paragraph (b)

If the governor requests further extension of a peacetime emergency beyond the time approved by the legislature, the governor must submit a new request and the legislature may only extend the emergency further by a three-fifths majority vote of each house.
